subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Cross-cutting runtime helper objects and routers: buffered binary stream reads, texture/surface format negotiation and packed-format decoders, image compositing, pure math utilities, destructor/free routing, and runtime dispatch-table trampolines.

summary: This packet groups 35 loosely-coupled runtime helper functions. Seven texture/vertex decoders (0x00509DE6, 0x00509E85, 0x00509F0C, 0x0050A067, 0x0050A0F0, 0x0050A2B4, 0x0050A34B) share one field layout (source base this+0x18, two strides this+0x1050/0x1054, element count this+0x1058, post-process flag this+0x10) and emit float RGBA with an optional ContactManifoldCleanup pass (0x00507845). Two buffer-read helpers (0x00501711, 0x005020BF) advance/copy through two-dword read trackers held at this+0x14 and this+0x54, with a longjmp underflow error. Three surface-format functions (0x00500680 table lookup, 0x005006A4 FourCC decode, 0x005029E5 BMP header gate) serve DDS/DDSTexture negotiation. ImageBoxFilterCompositor (0x00503533 scalar, 0x00503772 MMX, 0x00503888 function-pointer selector) performs 2x2 box downsampling. Five math helpers (0x0050C042 tolerance gate, 0x0050C0A6, 0x0050C15E, 0x0050C2E3 interpolations, 0x0050C5D0 matrix-vector) are pure computation. ObjectFreeRouter (0x00500FAE, 0x00502C1F, 0x0050B244, 0x0050B425, 0x0050B82B) covers destructor/conditional-free paths through FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) and ComplexDestructorWithLoop (0x00506FD9). DispatchTableRouter (0x0050C134, 0x0050C20D, 0x0050C2A6, 0x0050C2B3, 0x0050C2B9, 0x0050C48C, 0x0050C5BD, 0x0050C636, 0x0050C647) issues a sub_50FEA7(1) preamble then calls a global function-pointer slot (off_5D77E4..off_5D7894) whose target is swapped at runtime. 0x004FB900 is a lone forwarding wrapper. All groupings are DERIVED proposals; per-function owners remain UNKNOWN in the packet.

function_roles.role: Forwarding wrapper: calls sub_4FCA50 with the global unk_8AFEC0 as its argument and returns the result; no local state, guards, or control flow.
Linear search over a stride-9-element ID table (flt_5AD508..off_5D7150) returning the matched entry pointer or the fallback unk_5AD4E0 when empty/not-found; serves DDSTextureSurfaceCreation.
FourCC-to-format-identifier decoder: maps 909200416->50, 909200449->51, 909201952->20, 909201985->21, identity otherwise; used by DirectXSurfaceFormatNegotiation.
Conditional teardown helper: calls ArithmeticComparison_0f55(this) then FreeWrapper_7bcf(this) when bit 0 of a2 is set; returns this.
Buffer read-track advance: loads the tracker pointer at this+0x14, increments its +0 dword by a2, decrements its +4 dword by a2, returns the tracker.
Tracked binary read: copies a3 bytes from the tracker at this+0x54 into a2, raising a longjmp 'read error' via GuardedCallWithLongjmp on underflow; advances tracker and returns a3.
BMP header gate: on valid header (len>=14, 0x4D42 signature, declared size<=len) hands payload at +14 (len-14) to DDSTextureFormatValidationDecoding; otherwise returns error -2147467259.
Trivial forwarding wrapper: dereferences this[0] and passes it to FreeWrapper_7bcf, returning that call's result.
Scalar 2x2 box-average image compositor (channel-separated byte math, rounding 131074, carry base 0x00800080); misalignment fallback of the MMX wrapper.
MMX-vectorized 2x2 box-average compositor; dispatches to scalar ImageBlendingCompositing (0x00503533) when the row width is not 4-byte aligned.

Function-pointer selector: installs sub_503772 into off_5D76C0/off_5D76C4 when sub_50FC7D() is true, else ImageBlendingCompositing/F_2DImageBoxFilter (0x0050368A); then calls the primary pointer off_5D76C0.
Decodes 4-bit-per-channel packed color texels to float RGBA using the shared layout fields; optional ContactManifoldCleanup post-process gated by this+0x10.
Decodes 8-bit palette-indexed vertex color with an 8-bit alpha byte to float RGBA; alpha scaled by 0.0039215689 (flt_59E460); optional post-process gated by this+0x10.
Converts 8-bit palette-indexed pixels to float RGBA via the struct's embedded palette table; optional post-process gated by this+0x10.
Unpacks nibble-paired byte stream to float RGBA (low nibble to RGB, high nibble to alpha, scaled 0.06666667); optional post-process gated by this+0x10.
Decompresses packed 8-bit XY vertex positions to float RGBA (X,Y scaled 0.0078125, Z=0, A=1); optional post-process gated by this+0x10.
Decompresses packed 4-byte-per-element vertex data to float RGBA (each byte scaled 0.0078125); optional post-process gated by this+0x10.
Decodes signed int16 XY vertex pairs to float RGBA (X,Y scaled 0.000030517578, Z=0, A=1); optional post-process gated by this+0x10.
Mixed teardown (__userpurge): runs ComplexDestructorWithLoop over a2 then conditionally frees a1 via FreeWrapper_7bcf when bit 0 of a3 is set; returns a1.
Thunk trampoline forwarding the this pointer to VtableSetFreeChild; invoked from DestructorWithSelfFree (0x0050B75F).
Thunk trampoline (__usercall, a1 in EBP) forwarding a1 to ComplexDestructorWithLoop; invoked from DtorWithCleanup (0x0050B7AF).

Float near-zero tolerance check: returns TRUE when the double-precision difference of a1,a2 lies inside [-1.1920929e-7, +1.1920929e-7]; used as a pre-normalize gate by normalization/rotation routines.
2-component cubic Hermite interpolation (four standard basis functions, endpoint/tangent pairs in a2..a5, t=a6); no branches or callees.
Dispatch trampoline: sub_50FEA7(1) preamble then indirect call through off_5D7884 with six args forwarded; returns the callee's result.
Catmull-Rom Hermite cubic spline for a 2-component vector (four control points a2..a5, t=a6, 0.5 scale); no branches or callees.
Dispatch trampoline: sub_50FEA7(1u) preamble then indirect call through off_5D7888 with six args forwarded; returns the callee's result.
Dispatch wrapper (cdecl, no args): sub_50FEA7(1u) preamble then indirect call through off_5D77E4; returns the callee's result.
Bare thunk: indirect call through the global function pointer off_5D77E4 with no forwarded args; invoked by rotation-matrix and plane geometry routines.
Dispatch trampoline: sub_50FEA7(1u) preamble then indirect call through off_5D788C with six args forwarded; returns the callee's result.
3-component cubic Hermite/Bezier interpolation (four basis coefficients, four input vectors a2..a5, t=a6); no branches or callees.
Dispatch trampoline: sub_50FEA7(1u) preamble then indirect call through off_5D7894 with six args forwarded; returns the callee's result.
Forwarding thunk: indirect call through the global function pointer off_5D77F0 with no args; called by color-matrix/blend routines.
Transformed-vector computation: each output component is a three-term sum of products over stride-4 matrix elements of a3 against a2; writes a1[0..2], returns a1.
Dispatch wrapper (cdecl, no args): sub_50FEA7(1u) preamble then indirect call through off_5D7800; returns the callee's result.
Dispatch wrapper (cdecl, no args): sub_50FEA7(1u) preamble then indirect call through off_5D7804; returns the callee's result.

classes.name: BufferedStreamReader
classes.responsibility: Buffered binary stream read helper: advances a two-dword read tracker and copies bytes out with a longjmp underflow error path. Grouping proposal; the two tracker pointers sit at different offsets on the same this base.

classes.name: BufferReadTracker
classes.responsibility: Two-dword buffer read tracker: current read position at +0, remaining byte count at +4. Same layout at two different owner slots (this+0x14 and this+0x54); offsets are kept per-base and not merged.

classes.name: TextureDecodeFormat
classes.responsibility: Owns source-texture layout (source base at +0x18, two strides at +0x1050/+0x1054, element count at +0x1058) and a post-process flag at +0x10 for packed color/vertex decoders that emit float RGBA. Shared field set evidenced across seven decoders.

classes.name: DDSTextureFormatResolver
classes.responsibility: Texture/surface format negotiation helpers: ID lookup over a stride-9-element table with a fallback pointer, FourCC-to-format decoding, and a BMP header gate that forwards payloads to DDSTextureFormatValidationDecoding.

classes.name: ImageBoxFilterCompositor
classes.responsibility: 2x2 box-average image downsampling with scalar (0x00503533) and MMX (0x00503772) variants, plus a runtime function-pointer pair selector (0x00503888) that installs off_5D76C0/off_5D76C4.

classes.name: MathUtil
classes.responsibility: Pure math helpers: near-zero tolerance gate, Hermite/Catmull-Rom/Bezier interpolation, and a stride-4 3x3 matrix-vector transform. Output vector floats written at +0/+4/+8 of the output pointer.

classes.name: DispatchTableRouter
classes.responsibility: Runtime dispatch trampolines: sub_50FEA7(1) preamble followed by an indirect call through a global function-pointer slot (off_5D77E4/off_5D77F0/off_5D7800/off_5D7804/off_5D7884/off_5D7888/off_5D788C/off_5D7894); targets are assigned at runtime and may be swapped.

classes.name: ObjectFreeRouter
classes.responsibility: Destructor/free wrappers: conditional release through FreeWrapper_7bcf and thunks into ComplexDestructorWithLoop/VtableSetFreeChild. The grouping is a proposal; a2/a3 ownership flags are not resolved.

interfaces.name: TextureFormatDecoder
interfaces.purpose: Decode packed texture/vertex bytes (4-bit nibbles, 8-bit palette-indexed, 8-bit/16-bit vertex channels) into float RGBA quads using the shared layout fields this+0x18/0x1050/0x1054/0x1058, with an optional post-process pass via 0x00507845 gated by the this+0x10 flag.

interfaces.name: DispatchTrampoline
interfaces.purpose: Runtime-swappable call trampoline: run the sub_50FEA7(1) preamble, then invoke a global function-pointer slot with forwarded arguments and return its result; the concrete target is assigned at runtime.

compatibility_contracts.name: FourCCSurfaceFormatDispatch
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x005006A4 must map FourCC values 909200416->50, 909200449->51, 909201952->20, 909201985->21 and pass every other 32-bit value through unchanged; it is consumed by DirectXSurfaceFormatNegotiation (0x00502A15).

compatibility_contracts.name: BMPHeaderGate
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x005029E5 must accept a buffer only when the length is >= 14, the leading 16-bit value is 0x4D42 ('BM'), and the declared file size at +2 is <= length; on success it forwards (buffer+14, length-14) to DDSTextureFormatValidationDecoding (0x00500FCA) and on failure returns the error -2147467259.

compatibility_contracts.name: BufferReadUnderflowLongjmp
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x005020BF must raise a longjmp 'read error' (via GuardedCallWithLongjmp 0x00511869 with the string at 0x005ADB4C) when the requested read length exceeds the remaining count in the tracker at this+0x54; otherwise it copies a3 bytes, advances the tracker, and returns a3.

compatibility_contracts.name: IDTableLookupFallback
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x00500680 must linearly search the stride-9-element table spanning flt_5AD508..off_5D7150 matching the first DWORD of each entry against the ID and return the matching entry pointer, or the fallback pointer unk_5AD4E0 when the table is empty or the ID is not found.

compatibility_contracts.name: NearZeroToleranceGate
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x0050C042 must return nonzero exactly when |a1 - a2| <= 1.1920929e-7 (double-precision symmetric band) and zero otherwise; eleven normalization/rotation routines rely on it as the pre-normalize near-zero gate.

unresolved: unk_8AFEC0 (0x008AFEC0) is unnamed; sub_4FCA50 has no callee address or contract in the packet, so 0x004FB900's target is unresolvable statically.
Meaning of the unk_5AD4E0 fallback entry and the stride-9 entry layout beyond the first DWORD are unknown.
The concrete DirectX surface formats behind the four FourCC constants and their non-contiguous 20/21/50/51 mapping are not documented.
The a2 bit-0 flag in 0x00500FAE and the a3 ownership flag in 0x0050B244 are not semantically resolved.
Buffer tracker struct layout beyond the two dwords, and the units of the advance/count amounts, are caller responsibilities and unresolved here.
The longjmp guard error frame context for 0x005020BF is established elsewhere.
The role of 'this' in 0x005029E5 and the assumption that the BMP payload is a DDS/embedded texture decoded by 0x00500FCA are unproven.
Identity of the source/destination image surfaces for the compositors (0x00503533/0x00503772) and the truncated tail of the MMX pass are unproven.
What sub_50FC7D measures and the downstream consumer of the secondary pointer off_5D76C4 are unknown.
Decode channel ordering (which nibble/byte is red vs green vs blue) is inferred, and the true role of the 'ContactManifoldCleanup' (0x00507845) post-process is unresolved.
The embedded palette table base (indexed via this[4*index+12]) is inferred from source only; no packet field covers it.
Whether the 4-byte-per-vertex decode 0x0050A2B4 emits color or a position/tangent stream is not deterministically evidenced.
Global flt_59E780 (0x0059E780) cannot be confirmed as the 0.000030517578 scale in 0x0050A34B.
The spline constant globals (flt_59E43C, flt_59E450, flt_59E46C, flt_59E478, flt_59E7EC, flt_59E800) are not pinned to specific literals.
The runtime targets of the function-pointer slots (off_5D77E4/off_5D77F0/off_5D7800/off_5D7804/off_5D7884/off_5D7888/off_5D788C/off_5D7894) are unknown and swapped at runtime.
The stride-4 matrix storage order in 0x0050C5D0 is unconfirmed.
Self-references callee:0x0050C134/0x0050C20D/0x0050C2B9/0x0050C48C likely reflect dispatch-table aliases rather than recursion.
Endpoint/tangent and control-point roles of interpolation arguments are DERIVED, not stated by the source.
